_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every resume, cover letter and email. The pipeline may only select from, reorder and lightly adapt what's here. Every fact must stay true. Edit this file to change the base.
rules: Never state career length: no '25+ years', '30+ years', 'decades', 'a decade', 'ten years'. No graduation years.
List every employer from Havas onward with its real dates (Havas 2001-2007). Never hide where he worked or use 'Earlier career'. The 1998-2001 junior designer years are left off the resume.
Never name AI tools in prose (profile, cover letter, emails). Say 'the latest image and video platforms', 'generative image and video production'. The Tools row on the resume may list them.
Never invent facts, metrics, clients, SaaS experience, DAM systems or anything not in this file. If the posting wants something not here, list it under check_before_sending instead.
Location: never state a city or country. Use the location_line. Never answer a residency question falsely; flag knockout questions for Travis to answer himself.

Voice: conversational, direct, senior, plain. Contractions always. NO em dashes or en dashes in prose. No 'thrilled', 'excited', 'passionate', 'leverage', 'delve', 'I am writing to', 'great fit'. No neat aphorisms ('The real job isn't X. It's Y.'), no tidy lists of three. Self-deprecation at 20%.
Answer what the posting actually says. If the company or product isn't named, don't guess at it.
Salary target is not up for discussion; don't argue him out of applying.

Cover letters are ads with a readership of one. Structure per the ecd-cover-letter skill: paragraph 1 is an Idea about the READER (their name, their moment, their problem), never about Travis; proof lands as evidence of that idea, one campaign with one outcome, not a list; the close invites a reply with personality. If the first line could open anyone else's letter, rewrite it. Run every letter and outreach note through the humanizing pass before delivery.
